# bw Superbakeshop

> Philippine bakery chain selling freshly baked cakes, bread, and pastries,
> with online ordering for pickup and delivery, and a custom cake request
> service, across branches in Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao.

## What we sell
- Cakes, including custom/made-to-order celebration cakes
- Bread and pastries, baked fresh daily
- Online ordering with pickup or delivery

## Ordering
- Order online: https://www.bwsuperbakeshop.com/menu
- Request a custom cake: https://www.bwsuperbakeshop.com/custom-cake

## Store locations
- Find a branch (address, hours, phone, map): https://www.bwsuperbakeshop.com/stores
- Branches include: Quezon City, Makati, Pasig, Pampanga, Baguio (Luzon);
  Cebu, Iloilo (Visayas); Davao, Cagayan de Oro (Mindanao) — see /stores for
  the current, authoritative list; this file is not kept in lockstep with
  new branches.

## Franchise
- Franchise inquiries: https://www.bwsuperbakeshop.com/franchise
